insight: Built inside Intel in 2017 atop the VATIC video tool and open-sourced in 2018; the team spun out as CVAT.ai in 2022.
name: CVAT
tagline: Open-source annotation platform for vision AI datasets.
description: Data-labeling suite for images, video, and 3D: bounding boxes, polygons, segmentation, keypoints, and object tracking, with AI-assisted labeling via SAM and custom models through its API and SDK. Ships as the MIT-licensed Community edition to self-host, the hosted CVAT Online with free and paid plans, or a self-hosted Enterprise tier.

modelSupport.notes: AI-assisted labeling via SAM 2/3 or custom models connected through the API/SDK.

edge: One of the most widely deployed open-source CV labeling tools — millions of self-hosted installs, deep video tooling, and free MIT self-hosting.
pros: Self-host, hosted Online, or Enterprise tiers
cons: Annotation only — no model training built in

references.title: What is CVAT (Computer Vision Annotation Tool)?
